Poole The Jekyll Butler

Some useful hints to enhance this blog

30 Nov 2025

How to modify blog content (overview)

Content locations:

  • Posts: _posts/ — files named YYYY-MM-DD-title.md.
  • Pages: root .md files like about.md, or templates such as index.html, or files in top-level folders.
  • Includes/layouts: _includes/, _layouts/ — change structure/appearance.
  • Front matter: Each page/post begins with YAML front matter between ---. Common fields: title, layout, date, permalink, tags, categories.

  • Markdown & Liquid: Use Markdown for content. Embed Liquid tags (e.g., Poole) and include tags. To show an include tag literally use a raw block, for example:

    {% include head.html %}

  • Permalinks / URLs: Use permalink: in front matter or rely on site-wide permalink to control final URL. For a user site (petitmalo.github.io) keep baseurl: empty.
  • Preview locally: Run:
jekyll serve
# then open http://127.0.0.1:4000/ in browser
